heroHeadline: Lee–Takaichi Andong Summit Seals Japan-Korea Energy Pact; Samsung Strike Averted
heroSubtitle: Japan PM Takaichi's 4th summit with President Lee in Andong produced a landmark LNG/oil swap deal as both nations hedge against Hormuz disruption. Samsung's 47,000-worker strike was averted by a last-minute government-brokered deal (6.2% raises, 10.5% chip bonus). North Korean athletes visited the South for the first time in 7+ years. June 3 local elections are underway.
footerNote: Data sourced from official government records, Yonhap News, academic institutions, and major international outlets. Historical figures from Samguk Sagi, Joseon Wangjo Sillok, and peer-reviewed scholarship.
